items.stem:
A map is drawn to a scale of 1 : 50 000.
On the map, the distance between the villages of Aldbrook and Fenwick is 8 cm.

parts.t: Work out the actual distance between the two villages. Give your answer in kilometres.

ms:
M1 for 8 × 50 000 (= 400 000 cm) oe
A1 cao
allow M1 for 400 000 seen with no conversion
sols: A scale of 1 : 50 000 means 1 cm on the map represents 50 000 cm on the ground.
multiply the map distance by the scale factor

items.stem: A road atlas uses a scale of 1 : 200 000.

parts.t: Two petrol stations are 6.5 cm apart on the map. Work out the actual distance between them, in kilometres.

Complete this statement:
1 cm on the map represents …… km on the ground.

sols: convert the scale directly into kilometres

items.stem:
Priya draws a plan of her school hall.
She uses a scale of 1 cm to 4 m.

parts.t: The hall is 26 m long. Work out the length of the hall on the plan.
A door is 1.5 cm wide on the plan. Write down the actual width of the door.

sols: The scale is 1 cm to 4 m, so divide the real length by 4.
Multiply the plan length by 4 to get the real length.

items.stem:
A walking map has a scale of 1 : 25 000.
The straight track from the car park to the waterfall measures 5.6 cm on the map.

parts.t: Calculate the actual length of the track. Give your answer in kilometres.
Samira cycles along the whole track at an average speed of 12 km/h. Calculate the time she takes, in minutes.

ms:
M1 for their 1.4 ÷ 12 (= 0.11666… h) oe
A1 FT their (a)

items.stem: A map is drawn to a scale of 1 : 20 000.

parts.t: Show that an area of 1 cm<sup>2</sup> on the map represents an actual area of 4 × 10<sup>4</sup> m<sup>2</sup>.
A forest has an area of 12 cm<sup>2</sup> on the map. Calculate the actual area of the forest, in km<sup>2</sup>.

ms:
M1 for 20 0002 = 4 × 108 (cm2)
A1 for ÷ 10 000 leading to 4 × 104, nfww
sols: A length scale factor of 20 000 gives an area scale factor of 20 000<sup>2</sup>.
areas scale by the square of the length scale factor

items.stem: On a map, a straight canal of actual length 15 km is drawn 25 cm long.

parts.t: Find the scale of the map. Give your answer in the form 1 : n.
A railway line is 9 km long. Work out its length on this map.

ms:
M1 for 15 km = 1 500 000 cm soi
A1 cao, accept n = 60 000

M1 for 900 000 ÷ their 60 000 oe
A1 FT their (a)
sols: Write both lengths in the same unit.
write the ratio in the form 1 : n

items.stem: An architect makes a model of an office block using a scale of 1 : 150.

parts.t: The actual office block is 24 m tall. Calculate the height of the model, in centimetres.
One face of the model has an area of 6 cm<sup>2</sup>. Calculate the actual area of that face, in m<sup>2</sup>.

sols: work in a single unit before using the scale
The length scale factor is 150, so the area scale factor is 150<sup>2</sup> = 22 500.
areas scale by the square of the length scale factor

items.stem: Two towns are 12 cm apart on a map with a scale of 1 : 50 000.

parts.t: Calculate the actual distance between the two towns, in kilometres.

A second map of the same area has a scale of 1 : 20 000.
Work out the distance between the two towns on the second map.

ms:
M1 for 600 000 ÷ 20 000 oe or 12 × 50 000⁄20 000
A1 FT their (a)
sols: The actual distance does not change, only the scale does.
the second map has a smaller n, so it shows the same ground larger

items.stem: A scale model of a water tower is made using a scale of 1 : 250.

parts.t: The model is 92 cm tall. Calculate the height of the real water tower, in metres.
The model holds 32 cm<sup>3</sup> of water. Calculate the capacity of the real water tower, in m<sup>3</sup>.

ms:
M1 for 2503 (= 15 625 000) soi
M1 for 32 × their 15 625 000 (= 5 × 108 cm3)
A1 cao
sols: multiply the model length by the scale factor
The length scale factor is 250, so the volume scale factor is 250<sup>3</sup>.
volumes scale by the cube of the length scale factor

items.stem:
The diagram shows a triangular field ABC drawn on a map with a scale of 1 : 25 000.
On the map, AB = 4.8 cm, BC = 6.5 cm and angle ABC = 90°.

parts.t: Calculate the actual length of AC. Give your answer in kilometres, correct to 3 significant figures.
Calculate the actual area of the field. Give your answer in km<sup>2</sup>.

ms:
M1 for 1⁄2 × 4.8 × 6.5 (= 15.6 cm2)
M1 for × 25 0002 (= 9.75 × 109 cm2) oe
A1 cao
sols: Triangle ABC has a right angle at B, so use Pythagoras' theorem on the map lengths first.
the two perpendicular sides are the base and the height
areas scale by the square of the length scale factor
since 1 cm represents 0.25 km, 1 cm<sup>2</sup> represents 0.0625 km<sup>2</sup>
